name: Sharma Cafe — WhatsApp Agent (Low-Code / n8n version)

meta.description: Report ka Tarika 2 (Low-Code). Ye workflow Meta webhook se message leta hai, Supabase/Postgres me customer yaad rakhta hai, AI se Hinglish jawab banata hai aur wapas WhatsApp par bhejta hai. Bina Python server ke chhota setup chahiye to yahi use karo.

nodes.notes: Meta ye URL GET se check karta hai. hub.verify_token match hone par hub.challenge wapas bhejo.

nodes.name: 4. Message Aaya (POST)
nodes.notes: Customer ke messages yahan aate hain. Body: entry[0].changes[0].value.messages[0]

nodes.name: 11. Roz Raat 11 Baje (Owner Report + Birthday)
nodes.notes: Is branch se daily report, birthday wish aur winback chalte hain. Python version me ye app/automations.py karta hai.

parameters.query:
-- Aaj ki sale
select coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0) as sale, count(*) as orders
from orders
where payment_status = 'paid'
  and created_at::date = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata')::date;
